original_statement:
What must hold? State the invariant or expectation this concerns. A clean checkout of aspergillus main passes the command: pre-commit run --all-files --hook-stage manual.
What holds now? Describe the current, observed state. On a clean detached worktree of main (HEAD f750526), pre-commit run --all-files --hook-stage manual fails two hooks. eslint exits 2 with: ESLint couldn't find an eslint.config.(js|mjs|cjs) file. prettier fails with: files were modified by this hook, and reformats many non-JS tracked files such as docs/testing.md and contracts/specs/derived-asp-ce6.8.spec.json.
How do you see it? Describe exactly how to observe this for yourself — the steps to reproduce, or how you would demo it. Run: git -C /home/rix/code/git_puller/repos/aspergillus worktree add --detach <path> main. Then cd <path> and run: pre-commit run --all-files --hook-stage manual.
What constraints apply? State them in plain prose. Do not delete the eslint hook or the prettier hook. Do not add a path exclude that skips a whole tree to make a hook pass. Point each hook at the config and the files the language actually uses, for example typescript/configs/eslint.config.js for eslint. Keep the three local hooks the root config already runs: claude-md-coverage, check-subtree-edits, reroute-main-commit, session-trailer.
Where does this apply? (e.g. gateway route, mobile screen, CLI verb) .pre-commit-config.yaml at the aspergillus repo root
restatement: A clean checkout of aspergillus main must pass the command pre-commit run --all-files --hook-stage manual. Today the eslint hook fails because it cannot find an eslint config, and the prettier hook reformats non-JS tracked files such as docs/testing.md and contracts/specs/derived-asp-ce6.8.spec.json. The fix is in .pre-commit-config.yaml at the repo root. Each hook must point at the config and files its language uses, for example typescript/configs/eslint.config.js for eslint. Both hooks stay. No exclude that skips a whole tree is added. The four local hooks claude-md-coverage, check-subtree-edits, reroute-main-commit and session-trailer stay. The hooks must still do real work: eslint fails a TypeScript file with a real lint error, prettier fails a mis-formatted TypeScript file, and a hook that matches zero files does not count as a pass.

restatement_clauses.text: A clean detached worktree of aspergillus main passes the command: pre-commit run --all-files --hook-stage manual (exit code 0).
The eslint hook is not deleted from .pre-commit-config.yaml.
The prettier hook is not deleted from .pre-commit-config.yaml.
No path exclude that skips a whole tree is added to make a hook pass.
The eslint hook points at the config the language uses, typescript/configs/eslint.config.js.
The prettier hook runs only on the files its language uses, so it modifies no tracked files such as docs/testing.md or contracts/specs/derived-asp-ce6.8.spec.json.
The local hooks claude-md-coverage, check-subtree-edits, reroute-main-commit and session-trailer are still run by the root config.

A file under the TypeScript tree that contains a real lint error (for example an unused variable that the config forbids) fails the eslint hook, and the eslint hook matches at least one file on a clean checkout.
A mis-formatted TypeScript file fails the prettier hook, and the prettier hook matches at least one file on a clean checkout.

goal: The command pre-commit run --all-files --hook-stage manual passes on a clean checkout of aspergillus main, with the eslint and prettier hooks kept, pointed at the TypeScript config and files, and still able to catch real errors.
acceptance_criteria: On a fresh clean copy of main, the full manual pre-commit run finishes with no failing hook.
The pre-commit config still lists an eslint hook.
The pre-commit config still lists a prettier hook.
The pre-commit config has no exclude line that skips a whole top-level folder such as docs, contracts, typescript or python.
The pre-commit config names typescript/configs/eslint.config.js as the eslint config.
After the prettier hook runs on a fresh clean copy of main, it passes and has changed no tracked file.
The pre-commit config still names all four local hooks.
A TypeScript file with a real lint error, such as an unused variable, is added to a fresh copy of main. The eslint hook fails on it. The hook also checks at least one file on the clean copy.
A badly formatted TypeScript file is added to a fresh copy of main. The prettier hook fails on it. The hook also checks at least one file on the clean copy.
